comparison.objective: Disinfect an IV hub for 15 seconds before attaching and operating a syringe; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Record requires sustained rubbing contact, ordered connector approach and syringe manipulation. Candidate requires recessed hex-key use, counterholding, collar adjustment and dynamic testing.
comparison.success_condition: Record enforces 15 seconds of valid scrubbing before any syringe contact and then connection/flush stages. Candidate enforces repeated non-bottoming stops and retained setting; some numeric thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Procedural surface decontamination and medical connection test different abilities.
